description: This file contains implementation of Windows SSPI-based DIGEST-MD5 authentication for libcurl, including functions to check support, create auth messages, decode digest messages, and manage the associated data structures.

methods.name: bool Curl_auth_is_digest_supported(void)
methods.description: Checks if Windows SSPI supports DIGEST-MD5 authentication by querying the security package info.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_auth_create_digest_md5_message(struct Curl_easy * data,const struct bufref * chlg,const char * userp,const char * passwdp,const char * service,struct bufref * out)
methods.description: Generates an encoded DIGEST-MD5 response message for sending to the server.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_override_sspi_http_realm(const char * chlg,SEC_WINNT_AUTH_IDENTITY * identity)
methods.description: Extracts the realm from the challenge message and uses it as the domain in the SSPI identity structure.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_auth_decode_digest_http_message(const char * chlg,struct digestdata * digest)
methods.description: Decodes an HTTP Digest challenge message into its attributes.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_auth_create_digest_http_message(struct Curl_easy * data,const char * userp,const char * passwdp,const unsigned char * request,const unsigned char * uripath,struct digestdata * digest,char ** outptr,size_t * outlen)
methods.description: Generates an HTTP Digest response message, managing SSPI context and credentials.

methods.name: void Curl_auth_digest_cleanup(struct digestdata * digest)
methods.description: Cleans up the digest data structure, freeing resources associated with the context and tokens.
